children.text: 死者不得安息。无论你走到哪里，都能听见他们说话、低语、哭泣、尖叫。有时他们彼此交谈，有时独自絮叨。他们反复念叨着生前所爱的人、做过的工作，或是死前藏在木地板下的钱财。最常见的总是吃喝。死者永远饥饿。有时当他们发现你能听见，就会围拢到你耳边低语，托付最后的愿望。能帮的时候你总会帮，但他们想让你照顾的人往往也已经死了。你许下许多空头承诺，至少这能让他们安静下来。
事情并不总是如此。死者开始说话，是在你父亲死于法语区那栋猎枪式老宅的那天。你回到家，看见他站在客厅里自己的尸体旁；你还没来得及开口，他就消失了。从那天起，每当你吹起父亲的号角，就会听见一片嘈杂的人声。其中有些是人类。但还有别的东西——非人唇间刺耳的哀号，喉咙深处发出的哭喊，以及从阴影里窥视的一张张微光闪烁的幽灵面孔。
让帮你理清了这一切。他在波旁街的街角停下脚步，听你卖艺，注意到你久久凝视着脚边那个幽灵。他也看见了。让自我介绍说他是个灵媒，让你去布罗德莫区他的店里找他。他告诉你关于死者、关于坟墓彼端的一切，也告诉你与它们为伴太久要付出的代价。
是死者把你引到了阿卡姆。你靠着吹奏父亲的号角勉强维生；你吹奏时，死者的声音就更响。有时他们甚至称赞你的音乐。昨晚，让在四叶草俱乐部外找到了正在卖艺的你，几乎就像你们初次相遇那样。你看得出他不对劲：面容枯槁，像好几天没睡。让告诉你，你的父亲想见你……
继续阅读设置。
无论使用哪个版本的吉姆·卡尔弗，都按平行版调查员卡上的构筑要求组建灵魂牌库。把彼端（90052）签名牌与灵魂牌库一起置于吉姆·卡尔弗的场上。
收齐以下遭遇组的全部卡牌：安魂镇息、恶罪报应、安妮特的女巫集会、罪恶之城、在劫难逃、冥界、被困的灵魂、巫法。除安魂镇息外，均可在《万象无终》战役扩展中找到。
将《恶罪报应》遭遇组原本的剧本参考卡、幕与议程，以及幽灵迷网故事资产移出游戏；改用本扩展提供的剧本参考卡、幕与议程。
从每组双面地点中随机选 1 张放入场：绞刑架、异端者墓地、教堂地下室；并把教堂阁楼（C176a）放入场。其余版本的绞刑架、异端者墓地、教堂地下室以及教堂阁楼（C175a）移出游戏。然后放入闹鬼农田、废弃教堂与绞刑者河。
每个地点都以非幽灵面入场。注意：本关中途把地点从一面翻到另一面不算“揭示”新的地点。
在每个没有线索的地点上放置线索，直到每个地点至少有 1[per_investigator] 个线索。
每位调查员从绞刑者河开始游戏。
随机将 2 张异端者敌人移出游戏；把其余每张异端者敌人（敌人面朝上）洗入灵魂牌库。
将双面的让·德弗罗敌人以 Seeking Closure 面朝上生成在绞刑者河。
在以下地点下方各暗置 1 个饥饿之魂敌人：绞刑架、异端者墓地、教堂阁楼、教堂地下室。
本关使用两套相遇牌库。
把其余带幽灵特性的卡牌分离出来，洗成幽灵遭遇牌库。
把其余不带幽灵特性的卡牌洗成基础遭遇牌库。
本关设置两套遭遇牌库：基础遭遇牌库与幽灵遭遇牌库。通常情况下，调查员与遭遇牌库互动时使用基础遭遇牌库。但本关中地点可能翻到它的幽灵面；当调查员位于带幽灵特性的地点时，该调查员在所有场合改用幽灵遭遇牌库（包括抽牌、搜索、查看、揭示或以任何方式与遭遇牌库/弃牌堆互动）。两套牌库各有自己的弃牌堆。
闹鬼是出现在部分地点上的能力。每当调查员在调查地点时技能检定失败，在结算完该次检定的所有结果后，该调查员必须结算该地点上所有“闹鬼 -”能力。只要一个地点上有至少一条“闹鬼 -”能力（印刷或获得的），该地点对其他卡牌效果而言就是“闹鬼”的。
本扩展中的双面彼端签名资产允许吉姆·卡尔弗把灵魂牌库中的盟友资产作为灵魂附属到它上面。灵魂牌库是一副独立的牌库，在游戏开始时洗好并面朝下放在彼端旁。它免疫除彼端强制效果以外的所有玩家卡牌效果。灵魂在场但不占槽位，也没有生命/神智值，只保留名称与文本框。当一张独特的灵魂进入场时，弃掉所有与其同名的资产。如果一张附属的灵魂将被弃置，则改为放到灵魂牌库底。
部分敌人拥有巡逻关键词。在敌人阶段（框架步骤 3.2）中，每个重整且未交战的巡逻敌人沿最短路径向指定地点移动一次；指定地点有多个时由首席调查员选择。若移动被卡牌能力阻止，则该敌人不移动。
若没有任何调查员达成结局（每位调查员都撤退或被击败）：按结局 2 结算。
迷雾中幻影般的身影聚拢又消散。你握住让的手，灵媒昏死过去。黑暗里，你看见父亲的脸：他的笑纹、他和善的眼睛、他的微笑。父亲终于与你同在。这一瞬被让猛然倒吸一口气打断——他醒了，你父亲的脸随即消失，只留下你独自一人。你扶起让，听见父亲的声音在耳边鼓励你，压过了满耳争吵的鬼魂。你希望他永远不会安静下来。
吉姆·卡尔弗获得的经验等于胜利区每张敌人的胜利点数之和；其他每位调查员获得的经验等于胜利区每张地点的胜利点数之和。吉姆·卡尔弗可以把吉姆的小号升级为进阶版，或把进阶版《最终狂想曲》降级为原本版本。
让一边咒骂一边扶着你跌跌撞撞地离开绞刑者山丘，垂着头。“抱歉，我的朋友，”他说，“死者会说话，但他们并不总是愿意听。”非人之口发出的一记阴沉呼号扫过旷野，为灵媒的话作了注脚。
吉姆·卡尔弗获得的经验等于胜利区每张敌人的胜利点数之和；其他每位调查员获得的经验等于胜利区每张地点的胜利点数之和。吉姆·卡尔弗必须把《最终狂想曲》升级为进阶版，或把进阶版吉姆的小号降级为原本版本。

The dead don't rest. No matter where you go, you hear them talking, whispering, weeping, screaming. Sometimes to each other, sometimes alone. They ramble on about the people they loved, or their job, or the money they hid under the floorboards before they died. Usually it's about food or drink. The dead are always hungry. Sometimes when they realize you can hear them, they crowd 'round real close and whisper in your ear. Last wishes and such. You try to help when you can, but usually the folks they want you to take care of are dead, too. You make a lot of empty promises, but at least it keeps them quiet.

It wasn't always this way. The dead started talking the day your father died in his shotgun house in the French Quarter. You saw him standing over his own body in the living room when you came home; he vanished before you could say a word. From then on, whenever you played your father's trumpet, you could hear a cacophony of voices. Some of them were human. But there were others, too. Piercing wails from inhuman lips. Guttural cries. And a crowd of shimmering, spectral faces peering out from the shadows.

Jean helped you make sense of it all. He stopped to listen to you busking on a Bourbon Street corner and noticed the long look you gave to the ghost lying at your feet. He saw it too. Jean introduced himself as a medium and told you to meet him at his shop in Broadmoor. He told you all about the dead, and the things beyond the grave, and the price you'd pay if you kept company with 'em for too long.

It was the dead who led you to Arkham. You eke out a living playing your father's trumpet. The dead get louder when you play. Sometimes they even compliment your music. Last night, Jean found you busking outside the Clover Club, almost like the first time you met. You could tell something was wrong: his face was haggard, and he looked like he hadn't slept for days. Jean tells you that your father wants to see you...
Proceed to Setup.

Regardless of which version of Jim Culver is being played in this scenario, construct the spirit deck using the deckbuilding requirements on the parallel version of Jim Culver's investigator card. Put The Beyond signature asset along with the spirit deck into play in Jim Culver's play area.

Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: Laid to Rest, The Wages of Sin, Anette's Coven, City of Sins, Inexorable Fate, Realm of Death, Trapped Spirits, and Witchcraft. Each of these sets except for Laid to Rest can be found in The Circle Undone Campaign Expansion.

Remove the original scenario reference card, acts, agendas, and Spectral Web story assets from The Wages of Sin encounter set from the game. Use the new scenario reference card, acts, and agendas provided in the downloadable Laid to Rest encounter set when setting up the game.

Randomly choose one of the two The Gallows locations, one of the two Heretics' Graves locations, and one of the two Chapel Crypt locations and put them into play, along with Chapel Attic (C176a). Remove the other versions of The Gallows, Heretics' Graves, Chapel Crypt, and Chapel Attic (C175a) from the game. Then, put Haunted Fields, Abandoned Chapel, and Hangman's Brook into play.
Put each location into play on its non-Spectral side. Note: Flipping a location over from one side to another during this scenario does not reveal the new location.
Place clues on each location without clues until each location has at least 1 per-investigator clues on it.
Each investigator begins play in Hangman's Brook.
Remove two of the Heretic enemies from the game at random. Shuffle each remaining Heretic enemy into the spirit deck, enemy side faceup.
Spawn the double-sided Jean Devereux enemy at Hangman's Brook, Seeking Closure side faceup.
Place a Ravenous Spirit enemy facedown beneath the following locations: The Gallows, Heretics' Graves, Chapel Attic, and Chapel Crypt.
This scenario utilizes two separate encounter decks.
Separate each of the remaining cards with the Spectral trait and shuffle them together to build the spectral encounter deck.
Shuffle each of the remaining cards without the Spectral trait together to build the standard encounter deck.

During the setup of this scenario, two encounter decks are constructed: a standard encounter deck and a spectral encounter deck. Whenever an investigator would interact with the encounter deck, that investigator should use the standard encounter deck. However, locations may flip over to their Spectral side. While an investigator is at a location with the Spectral trait, that investigator should use the spectral encounter deck instead for all purposes, including drawing, searching, looking at, revealing, or otherwise interacting with the encounter deck or encounter discard pile. If an effect specifically refers to one of the two decks, it interacts with the specified deck regardless of the investigator's location. Each of the two encounter decks has its own discard pile.

Haunted is an ability that appears on some locations. Each time an investigator fails a skill test while investigating a location, after applying all results for that skill test, that investigator must resolve all Haunted abilities on that location. A location is haunted for the purposes of other card effects if it has at least one Haunted ability.

specialRules.title: The Beyond and the Spirit Deck

children.text: The double-sided The Beyond signature asset allows Jim Culver to attach Ally assets from the spirit deck to it as spirits. The spirit deck is a separate deck that is shuffled facedown next to The Beyond when the game begins. It is immune to all player card effects except for the forced effect on The Beyond. Spirits are in play but only retain their names and text boxes. Spirits do not take up any slots and do not have health or sanity values. When a unique spirit enters play, discard any assets that share its name. If an attached spirit would be discarded, it is placed on the bottom of the spirit deck instead.

Some enemies have the patrol keyword. During the enemy phase, each ready, unengaged enemy with the patrol keyword moves to a connecting location along the shortest path toward the designated location. If there are multiple locations that qualify as the designated location, the lead investigator may choose which location the enemy moves toward. If an enemy with patrol would be compelled to move to a location that is blocked by a card ability, the enemy does not move.
If no resolution was reached (each investigator resigned or was defeated): Proceed to Resolution 2.

Phantasmagoric shapes form and recede in the mist around you. As you take Jean's hands, the medium falls into a dead faint. In the dark, you glimpse your father's face: his laugh lines, his kind eyes, his smile. Your father is with you at last. The moment is broken by a sudden, gasping breath as Jean awakens. Before you can react, your father's face winks out of sight, leaving you alone. Despite the knot in your stomach, you feel a sense of relief in knowing that your father was here, however briefly, and that he saw you. As you help Jean to his feet, you hear your father's voice in your ear, whispering encouragement over the riot of ghosts bickering in your ears. You hope he never goes quiet.

Jim Culver earns experience equal to the combined Victory X value of each enemy in the victory display. Each other investigator earns experience equal to the combined Victory X value of each location in the victory display. Jim Culver may either upgrade Jim's Trumpet to its advanced version, or downgrade the advanced version of Final Rhapsody to its original version.

Jean cusses as you stumble away from Hangman's Hill, head hung low. “Sorry, my friend,” he says. “The dead speak, but they don't always listen.” A mordant call from inhuman lips sweeps across the expanse, underscoring the medium's words.

Jim Culver earns experience equal to the combined Victory X value of each enemy in the victory display. Each other investigator earns experience equal to the combined Victory X value of each location in the victory display. Jim Culver must either upgrade Final Rhapsody to its advanced version, or downgrade the advanced version of Jim's Trumpet to its original version.
